turns.question: What was net revenue on 1 October 2026, after partner returns?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR) on 1 October 2026 was 964.19 EUR. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.

turns.question: How was that number computed?
turns.answer: Net revenue (EUR) is defined as "Revenue minus partner returns (finance's net sales)." In plain words, the query summed the amounts of all non-cancelled orders placed on 1 October 2026 (revenue), summed the amounts of partner returns recorded on 1 October 2026 (returns), and subtracted returns from revenue, giving 964.19 EUR for that day. Fresh: returns.silver is ready up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z. Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
